monitoring_enabled.description: Whether CopyQ monitors the system clipboard.

max_history_items.description: Maximum number of items to store in clipboard history; 0 means unlimited.

separator.description: Separator string used when joining or exporting clipboard items.

auto_save_interval.description: Interval in seconds between automatic saves; 0 disables auto-save.

theme.description: Theme name (e.g., 'light', 'dark') or path to a custom theme file.

tray_icon_enabled.description: Whether the system tray icon is shown.

show_notifications.description: Whether to show desktop notifications for new clipboard items.

ignore_applications.description: Whether to ignore clipboard items from specified applications.

ignore_applications_list.description: List of application names (WM_CLASS strings) to ignore. Only used if ignore_applications is true.

ignore_text.description: Whether to ignore clipboard items containing specified substrings.

ignore_text_list.description: List of text substrings to ignore. Only used if ignore_text is true.

tabs.description: List of named tabs to create. Each tab has a 'name' field.
